description:
Construction cost index series for a development appraisal's cost side:
    `basis` is tender (tender price indices), output (output price indices),
    deflator (the construction deflator) or labour. Optional `sector`
    (residential, commercial, industrial, infrastructure, all, …), `freq`
    (monthly | quarterly | annual) and an inclusive period window in the
    series' own format (2014Q1, 2014M01, 2014). Each series carries its base
    period and method. UK-wide; regional factors come with the site appraisal.
    UK only. Free.
name: cost_index
title: Construction cost index series
